title: A Horse's Quiet Route Through Nature
caption:
FROM WATER TO WOODLAND. Separate real horse scenes show drinking, grazing and moving across open ground. #WildVox #Horses #Nature

narration_timeline.text: At the water's edge, a pale horse lowers its head to drink, staying close to the shore.
narration_timeline.scene: Clear pale horse actually drinking from a water edge in source_01, not grazing

narration_timeline.text: Another horse grazes on the bank, choosing grass while water remains nearby.
narration_timeline.scene: Real pale/tan horse grazing on shore bank in source_00, not drinking

narration_timeline.text: Elsewhere, a small group shifts across open shore ground and pauses together.
First, a horse stands beside a person. In another field, a different horse grazes.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic grazing horse in one source; another horse next to an actual person in separately filmed scene

narration_timeline.text: Other herds explore grassy wetland edges, moving between patches of open ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Real herds and grazing horses filmed on separate wetland shores

narration_timeline.text: A white horse feeds among trees, ending this journey with a quieter scene.
narration_timeline.scene: White horse grazing by woodland trees
